en.title: Rosario Dawson's Mom Reacts to Her Spider-Man Cameo Being Cut
en.summary: The actress revealed a scene she filmed for the latest Spider-Man film was ultimately left on the cutting room floor. Her mother's reaction highlights a relatable disappointment for fans and creators alike.
en.body:
It’s a tale as old as cinema: a scene is filmed, a character is introduced, and then, for reasons of pacing, runtime, or narrative necessity, it’s gone. For **Rosario Dawson**, this reality hit close to home when a scene she shot for **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** was ultimately cut from the final film. Dawson, who has endeared herself to fans as the resilient nurse **Claire Temple** (the Night Nurse) across Netflix’s Marvel universe, shared the news at a recent fan convention.

Dawson, a fan favorite for her portrayal of Claire Temple – the character who patched up Matt Murdock and later found herself entangled with Luke Cage – expressed her own disappointment. "I even shot a scene in the new Spider-Man movie, but I got cut out," she revealed. While the specifics of the scene remain undisclosed, it’s understood to have involved Claire Temple interacting with Peter Parker in a hospital setting, a moment that would have further woven the interconnected threads of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. The film's writers acknowledged the difficulty of trimming such a packed narrative, with co-writer **Chris McKenna** noting the "embarrassment of riches" of characters and scenes they had to work with.

## A Mother's Disappointment, A Fan's Hope

The most endearing part of Dawson’s revelation, however, came from her mother’s reaction. When **Rosario Dawson** shared the news, her mom’s immediate response was one of relatable frustration. "I told my mom, and she was like, ‘That sucks. Now I can’t post the [behind the scenes] pictures [on social media],’" Dawson recounted. This sentiment perfectly captures the dual disappointment: not only is a character’s appearance erased, but the tangible, shareable moments of connection are lost too. It’s a small but significant detail that underscores the personal impact of these cinematic decisions on those closest to the talent involved and, by extension, the wider fan community.

## What's Next for Claire Temple?

Despite the sting of her scene being cut, **Rosario Dawson** remains optimistic about reprising her role as Claire Temple. The character has become a pivotal figure in the street-level corner of the Marvel universe, acting as a crucial ally and confidante to multiple heroes. Fans are eager to see Claire return, and Dawson’s continued enthusiasm suggests that this might not be the last we see of the Night Nurse, even if her potential appearance in **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** remains a 'what if' scenario.

This past weekend, Rosario Dawson was asked which superhero character she would like to work with. “Well, I’m going to have to say — I could have said Spider-Man,” Dawson said during her appearance at GalaxyCon . “I even shot a scene in the new Spider-Man movie, but I got cut out.” Dawson’s character, Claire Temple, the Night Nurse, first appeared in Netflix’s version of Daredevil , and went on to appear in Jessica Jones , Luke Cage , Iron Fist , and The Defenders . She has chemistry with Matt after she helps him out after finding him bloody in a dumpster; she later has a relationship with Luke Cage (Mike Colter). She has a lot of practice helping superheroes; naturally, her nursing skills come in quite handy. According to The Wrap , Claire’s scene with Spider-Man (Tom Holland) would have taken place in a hospital, right before Peter visits Bruce at a college. Brand New Day writer Chris McKenna said, “Rosario Dawson is great. I wasn’t there for those discussions. But it was great. If anything, you have a movie that is two-and-a-half hours long, and it’s almost an embarrassment of riches with so many great characters and so many great scenes.” McKenna’s co-writer, Erik Sommers, concurred: “The scene they did was a good scene. I think the only reason it’s not in the final cut was just it was probably cut for time because it was very good.” Dawson expressed her disappointment to GalaxyCon-goers, saying, “I told my mom, and she was like, ‘That sucks. Now I can’t post the pictures.’ And I was like, ‘Right mom, me being cut out of the movie that has the largest viewership of a trailer ever, the issue is you can’t post the BTS photos.’” Many other characters can currently be seen in Spider-Man: Brand New Day , which is now in theaters.
